evals.name: message-from-staged-diff
evals.setup: A staged diff adding a JWT login endpoint: a new `handler/login.go` with `Login`, a `token.Issue` helper, and the route wired into the router. The conversation that produced it discussed session cookies at length — a design the diff does not contain.

evals.name: amend-from-hash
evals.setup: `HEAD` is a commit whose message reads "fixes". Its diff corrects an off-by-one in a pagination cursor. Separately, an unrelated `.gitignore` change is sitting staged in the index — content the message is not derived from.
